vulnerabilities.description: Automerge vulnerability/security PRs. Requires the Renovate bot to be able to merge.

disableBypassExternal.description: Disable automerge for updates that bypass minimum release age (lockFileMaintenance, digest, pin, replacement).

packageRules.description: Disable automerge for lock file maintenance (bypasses minimum release age)
Disable automerge for digest updates (bypasses minimum release age)
Disable automerge for pin updates (bypasses minimum release age)
